name: Hero Decision
summary: A focused decision with one dominant action, prominent headline and subtitle, and optional secondary action.
bestUse: Decisive single-action pages, daily focus prompts, welcome/onboarding moments, and clear milestone choices.
constraints: Requires a clear primary action. Keeps content calm and uncluttered without distracting secondary lists.

name: Glance Dashboard
summary: Metrics, progress, and status indicators designed for high-frequency glanceable consumption.
bestUse: Today views, progress trackers, daily summaries, telemetry, and live status displays.
constraints: Highlights a monumental metric or radial progress ring with serene status micro-sentences.

name: Focus Wizard
summary: Step-by-step input with sequential progression, focused field presentation, and persistent action dock.
bestUse: Multi-field forms, onboarding questionnaires, guided check-ins, and multi-step data entry.
constraints: Partitions form fields into sequential steps with dedicated advance/submit actions.

name: Bento Overview
summary: A compact overview of related content arranged in squircle bento tiles with icons, status, and badges.
bestUse: Hub pages, category grids, collection summaries, control centers, and resource cards.
constraints: Organizes collection items or detail facts into structured 2-column squircle bento tiles.

name: Content Canvas
summary: Media-led content presentation with high-ratio media frames, generous editorial spacing, and reading rhythm.
bestUse: Articles, item showcases, visual guides, recipes, product profiles, and editorial narratives.
constraints: Leads with prominent photography/media and preserves calm editorial typography.

name: System Settings
summary: Grouped preferences, switches, and navigation links organized into standard platform groups.
bestUse: App preferences, account configuration, notification toggles, privacy controls, and links.
constraints: Grouped rows with divider rules, clean switch controls, and explicit navigation links.
